module_outcomes: Analyse the importance of soils and explain soil classification and formation.
Interpret soil physical and chemical properties and relate them to crop production and environmental function.
Analyse how soil organisms and soil organic matter contribute to soil properties and nutrient cycling.
Explain the movement and uptake of plant nutrients and evaluate nutrient management
Evaluate soil degradation processes and propose soil and water conservation measures, including erosion control.
consultation_times: Days of the week Times Venues Tuesdays* 11h30 – 13h20* AL13* *Any changes will be communicated
module_purpose: The purpose of this module is to equip learners with the knowledge and understanding of soils in relation to their ability to sustain plant growth, while developing the applied competence required to interpret soil information for land management and production contexts. Since the module serves a multidisciplinary cohort (Agronomy, Agribusiness, Animal Science, Hydrology, and Geography), it focuses on soil science concepts that can be applied across crop production, grazing systems, catchment and water management, and land evaluation.
